snippet.title: HOLLOW MIRE - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Are you ready to uncover the truth buried in memory and loss?

HOLLOW MIRE is a narrative thriller set in post-war England, blending mystery, psychological tension, and player-driven choices.

Search for your missing family, connect fragmented stories, and face a haunting past that refuses to stay buried.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357160/HOLLOW_MIRE/

🔥 About the Game

🧩 A Dual Narrative Mystery
• Follow intertwined stories across past and present
• Uncover secrets through investigation and memory fragments

🧠 Psychological Thriller
• Experience a haunting atmosphere filled with tension and uncertainty
• Explore themes of trauma, loss, and the aftermath of war

🗣️ Choice-Driven Story
• Your decisions shape the outcome
• Multiple endings based on your actions

🎭 Fully Voiced Experience
• Professional voice acting brings characters to life
• Emotional storytelling supported by a rich soundtrack

🌍 Immersive Setting
• Explore snowy post-war England and atmospheric locations
• Travel between timelines, including D-Day events

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains disturbing themes, psychological tension, and references to war. Player discretion is advised.
